verdict.rationale: Otter AI Chat is an AI assistant that queries connected apps, so being an MCP client is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence documents only Otter's own MCP server, which exposes Otter meeting data to Claude and ChatGPT. That is the server role, not the ability to plug external MCP servers into Otter. The built-in CRM, document and other integrations are adjacent features, not MCP client support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
